date.as_written: saṃvat 1716 varṣe māsa kārttika sudi paurṇamāsi gurudine

notes: The scribe is unnamed (only mentioned generally in 'lekhaka pāṭhakayo śubhaṃ bhavatu'). The word 'śūramṛhāṭha' preceding the author's name is obscure and possibly corrupt (perhaps an epithet, title, family name, or place).
